function.name: acl_read_file
function.description: Read an exact authorized UTF-8 file. Returns content and sha256 for a subsequent write.

function.name: acl_write_file
function.description: Atomically replace an exact authorized UTF-8 file. Supply expected_sha256 from read, or absent for an authorized new file.
